_note: Used by scripts/sync-hackiosx.mjs. hackiosx.dev is prose, so this file says, sentence by sentence, which tracker areas each sentence on https://hackiosx.dev/projects supports, checked by hand against the page on 2026-11-24. The sync writes a state only for a sentence that is on the live page exactly as written here; a sentence the page adds or rewords is reported as unmapped and writes nothing until it is added here. projects: the three main projects, keyed by the page's h2 id; works and missing map a list item (exact text) to [area, state] pairs, an empty list means the sentence names no tracker area. ports: the community ports table, keyed by the repo the page links (canonical name), with the State column text and its areas. repo_aliases: names the page links that GitHub redirects (renames). new_devices: phones the page lists that the tracker did not have. repos: new repos, checked on GitHub (fork parent, default branch).
